primary.metric: Full256-vocabulary first-answer accuracy; exact4, complete maps and absence separately

first_class_balance: Present first characters exactly balanced a-h at24 histories per cell; restricted nine-character choice diagnostic only; no mask during optimization or scoring.
wrong_history: Same keys/position and independent fixed filler offsets; change only quotation source classes by+1, preserve original labels.
query_swap: For present4-key queries, ask the next key and score original target; one-key query_swap is an identity control and not a causal falsifier.
